title: ÆTHER: Midnight Metro (nostalgic synthwave, 3 min)
story: Mumbai, 1 AM. A young woman rides the last metro home after a long day; the city lights blur past; she smiles at an old memory. It wasn't a sad story.

brief.notes: Jithesh 1 Nov: 3-4 songs, 3 min, inspired by the EDM list incl. 'Classique' by Adieu Aru (French touch / chillsynth). Traits only, no names in the prompt. Bittersweet, nostalgic, warm. Soft female humming (he loves it). Charukesi in C (major lower half, minor upper half = happy-sad). Prompt mode, 180 s, 2 takes, one at a time.

prompt: A nostalgic, dreamy chillsynth and French-touch electronic track, 3 minutes, 104 BPM, warm and bittersweet, happy and a little sad at once: a late-night metro ride through a glittering Indian city. Warm vintage analog synth arpeggios, a filtered disco-house groove that slowly opens up, a rubbery melodic bass, soft gated snare, shimmering pads. The melody is a raga-shaped tune in Raga Charukesi in C (C D E F G Ab Bb) with gentle slides and ornaments, carried by a soft wordless female humming voice and a glassy synth lead. Timeline: 0-20 s: the arpeggio alone, filtered and warm, the humming enters softly. 20-50 s: the filtered groove and bass join, the hook on the humming voice. 50-80 s: the filter opens wide, full groove, the hook on a bright synth lead, a bansuri answers it. 80-110 s: a dreamy breakdown, only pads, humming and a soft piano, then a drum fill. 110-150 s: the biggest section, full groove, humming and synth lead in harmony, sparkling arpeggios, the hook a little higher. 150-180 s: the groove thins out layer by layer, the humming sings the hook one last time over the arpeggio, ending on a warm held chord. Real instruments named as themselves are played by real musicians, close, natural and dry, no heavy echo. No white-noise risers, no side-chain pumping on acoustic instruments, no long gaps, no fade-out at the start, no words unless stated.
